integrity: Proof supplied by complete exhaustive enumeration with two independently implemented constructions and all-sources breadth-first search; recorded outputs reproduced from package source files.
limitations: Exact exhaustive finite result only for nine matched pairs; no extrapolation to greater orders; previously known graph size, component sizes and edge count not claimed as new; publication priority not independently established.
title: Exact center and eccentricity spectrum of disjoint-compatible matchings on eighteen convex points
